component.name: Harbor
component.summary: SSH 客户端与远程工作台

description.p: Harbor is a terminal-centric remote workbench: a Vault for credentials and hosts, SSH and local terminals, SFTP file management, port forwarding, shared console sessions, remote desktop, and encrypted sync between devices.
Harbor 是以终端为核心的远程工作台：保存凭据与主机的 Vault、 SSH 与本地终端、SFTP 文件管理、端口转发、共享控制台会话、 远程桌面，以及设备间的加密同步。
